blocks.text: The Miss Universe Organization (MUO) faction affiliated with Raul Rocha has revoked the franchise agreement with Nawat Itsaragrisil following an exchange of accusations between the two warring sides. In a statement released on the official Miss Universe Instagram account, the organization said Nawat Itsaragrisil’s established “Miss Universe Easern Pte. Ltd.” has no authority to use the Miss Universe brand in any territory, nor does it have authority to grant operational rights. Nawat has control and access to the Miss Universe website and official Facebook and X (formerly Twitter) pages, while Rocha’s faction holds the official Miss Universe Instagram account.
